content: घटः [घट-अच्] .²1 A large earthen water-jar, pitcher, jar, watering-pot; आकाशमेकं हि यथा घटादिषु पृथग्भवेत् <ls>Y. 3. 144</ls>; कूपे पश्य पयोनिधावपि घटो गृह्णाति तुल्यं जलम् <ls>Bh. 2. 49</ls>. .²2 The sign Aquarius of the zodiac (also called कुम्भ). .²3 An elephantʼs frontal sinus. .²4 Suspending the breath as a religious exercise. .²5 A measure equal to 20 droṇas. .²6 A part of a column; स्तम्भं विभज्य नवधा वहनं भागो घटोऽस्य भागोऽन्यः <ls>Bṛ. S. 53. 29</ls>. .²7 A border. .²8 A peculiar form of a temple; <ls>Bṛ. S. 56. 18</ls>, <ls n="Bṛ. S. 56.">26</ls>. .²9 The head; ‘घटः समाधिभेदे ना शिरः कूटकटेषु च’ <ls>Med.</ls>; <ls>Mb. 1. 155. 38</ls>.
